change: Remove the RTT-specific early return from Copter ESC calibration startup check.
intent: Move ArduCopter behaviour back toward upstream semantics; missing RC input must be handled by the HAL/RCInput/board layer, not by skipping vehicle-level ESC calibration logic.
notes: The SITL-on-HW gate was intentionally not used as final verdict for this firmware state because current parameters are physical/default style: AHRS_EKF_TYPE=3 and GPS1_TYPE=1, not the SITL-on-HW expected AHRS_EKF_TYPE=10 and GPS1_TYPE=100.
The old rtt_fast_green_gate red result was separated from this source change by running an explicit SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL/GET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL physical gate, which passed.
